Fancaps 4M Re-encoded Dataset
	

This is the re-encoded dataset of deepghs/fancaps_full. And all the resized images are maintained here.
There are 29004217 images in total. The maximum ID of these images is 31449533. Last updated at 2025-09-04 22:10:59 JST.

	
		
	
	
		How to Painlessly Use This
	

Use cheesechaser to quickly get images from this repository.
Before using this code, you have to grant the access from this gated repository. And then set your personal HuggingFace token… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepghs/fancaps-webp-4Mpixel.
